rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260) coverage
rules.requirement: The Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260 of the Jersey City Municipal Code, regulates rents and is enforced by the Office of Landlord Tenant Relations. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control.
rules.coverage_text: Rental properties in Jersey City with five or more units; all 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control. The ordinance provides certain other exemptions from rent regulation.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control. The ordinance provides certain other exemptions, which an owner may request through a Rent Control Exemption Request.
rules.citation: Jersey City Municipal Code Chapter 260 (Rent Control Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
